decks.notes: This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly amassing creatures on the battlefield and dealing damage to the opponent as fast as possible. With a mix of aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bonecrusher Giant, along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Chained to the Rocks, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents early in the game. Showdown of the Skalds provides card advantage and temporary buffs to the creatures, while Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional mana and flexibility to the deck.

This UW Control deck focuses on disrupting opponent's plans, controlling the board through counterspells and removal, and generating card advantage through card draw and manipulation. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by efficiently answering threats and creating advantageous board states, leading to victory through incremental advantage and card advantage. The key strategy involves setting up a lock on the board using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, while leveraging powerful finishers like Dream Trawler and The Wandering Emperor to close out the game.

The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana using mana dorks like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, as well as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, to cast powerful green creatures and spells. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption, while cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival help maintain card advantage and consistency. Cityscape Leveler offers a win condition if the game goes long, making this a fast-paced and efficient deck.

The main concept of this Aggro Azorius Tempo/Spirit Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced, aggressive strategy using efficient creatures like Rattlechains, Mausoleum Wanderer, Spell Queller, and Supreme Phantom. By capitalizing on tempo plays and card advantage through cards like Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to control the game while applying pressure on the opponent. Utilizing disruptive elements like Lofty Denial, Shacklegeist, and Geistlight Snare, along with evasion provided by creatures like Brazen Borrower and Katilda, Dawnhart Martyr, the deck is designed to maintain board presence and secure victory.

The main objective of this deck is to quickly build up green mana devotion in order to generate massive amounts of mana with Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx. This mana can be used to cast powerful green threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, while also enabling big plays with Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival. The deck also includes cards like Oath of Nissa and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to help filter through the deck and find key pieces. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its efficient ramp and powerful green creatures.

The deck focuses on using Transmogrify to cheat a high-cost creature onto the battlefield, such as Mirrex, Atraxa, or Sokenzan, to gain a powerful advantage over the opponent. The deck includes cards like Tribute to Horobi and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to support the combo strategy. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds additional synergy to the deck's strategy. The mana base is primarily black and red with a splash of white and colorless for flexibility in casting spells. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to swarm the board with low-cost creatures and use cards like Reckless Bushwhacker and Venerated Loxodon to pump them up for a big attack. Cards like Thraben Inspector and Ornithopter help to maintain card advantage and tempo, while cards like Sacred Foundry and Battlefield Forge provide the mana base needed for consistent aggression. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of synergy to the deck, allowing for even more explosive turns and overwhelming board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Elvish Mystic and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful green creatures and spells such as Cavalier of Thorns and Storm the Festival. The deck focuses on generating a high devotion to green to fuel cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and activating Nykthos for massive amounts of mana. The deck also utilizes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Old-Growth Troll for additional threats and versatility. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures for additional flexibility and protection.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board presence with low-cost Spirit creatures while disrupting opponent's game plan with counterspells like Lofty Denial and Shacklegeist. The deck aims to maintain tempo by utilizing cards like Curious Obsession to draw cards and maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Spell Queller and Supreme Phantom enhances the synergies within the deck, allowing for a quick and aggressive game plan. The deck also includes some utility cards like Otawara, Soaring City and Slip Out the Back for additional versatility.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively sacrifice creatures and deal damage to the opponent's life total. The deck utilizes cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Bloodtithe Harvester to keep the pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board and disrupt the opponent's plans. By efficiently sacrificing creatures and dealing damage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The key concept of this deck is to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy using Azorius tempo and Spirit creatures. By utilizing cards like Spell Queller, Supreme Phantom, and Curious Obsession, the deck aims to control the game tempo and disrupt opponent's plans while dealing damage quickly with efficient creatures. The inclusion of cards like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare help to further control the board while maintaining pressure. The deck also includes a few disruptive spells like Lofty Denial and Slip Out the Back to disrupt opponent's plays. Overall, the deck focuses on utilizing tempo and aggro strategy to secure victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cycle through cards to fill the graveyard with spells, enabling an early return of Arclight Phoenix to the battlefield. Utilizing cheap card draw and removal spells, the deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent with recurring fliers. Young Pyromancer provides additional token generation, while Thing in the Ice can flip to clear the board. The inclusion of extra turn spells like Temporal Trespass adds a burst of aggression when needed. Overall, the deck excels at creating a fast-paced and proactive game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also utilizing green devotion to power up cards like Wolfwillow Haven and Cavalier of Thorns. The deck also includes strong aggro creatures like Old-Growth Troll and Storm the Festival to pressure the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Boseiju, Who Endures provides utility and protection against opposing strategies. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast mana production and powerful creatures.
